pkgmetadata.longdescription: stamp-suite implements the Simple Two-Way Active Measurement Protocol (STAMP, RFC 8762) and its optional extensions (RFC 8972) for measuring round-trip time, packet loss and one-way delay. A single binary runs as the Session-Sender or, with --is-reflector, as the Session-Reflector.

use.flag: Build the reflector control API (HTTP on loopback by default, optional HTTPS through rustls) for runtime key, session, limit, drain and shutdown management
Use kernel software receive and transmit timestamps (SO_TIMESTAMPING) instead of userspace timestamps; NIC hardware timestamps are attempted only with --hwtstamp on, which needs CAP_NET_ADMIN
Build the SNMP AgentX subagent and install the STAMP-SUITE-MIB
